text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Smooth drift path of the convex model with drift (G-all+D1) at the 2025-07-01 cut, less each path's own mean, in points of effective capacity. Night is 00:00 to 05:59, morning 06:00 to 10:59, midday 11:00 to 15:59, evening 16:00 to 23:59 local time. A forecast holds the last value.'
